preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of intersections is between 2 and 10, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 1 and N * (N - 1) / 2, inclusive.
Each road connects intersections between 1 and N, inclusive.
The length of each road is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
No road connects an intersection to itself.

preconditions.expression: There is at least one path from Tomya's house to Ciel's restaurant.
preconditions.description: There is a path from the 1st intersection to the N-th intersection.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the number of shortest paths from Tomya's house to Ciel's restaurant for the i-th test case
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the number of shortest paths from Tomya's house to Ciel's restaurant.
